semanticOwner: BuildResultViewModel remains the only owner of the latest committed output and the Build Completed modal; CompositionRunPresentationViewModel remains the only run-result projection owner and reaches the shell only through CompositionRunStateBindings; ReportPresentationViewModel remains the only owner of the loaded report, report history and report toast.
terminalContract: After a Build output commits and its report is unavailable (a cancellation or a handled report failure), the committed output path becomes the latest committed output, so the latest-output shortcut appears on the composition pages without opening the Build Completed modal; the run result keeps the path, size and SHA-256. A generated-report publication that fails leaves the loaded report, its JSON, the report history and the report toast as they were before the attempt and rethrows, so a report-unavailable result is never accompanied by that report; a successful publication is unchanged. Behavior before the output commits, the normal success path, every output byte, name and range, and the loose-delivery handling are unchanged.
